title: Call records
detail: Create a private summary of a call. Records never include audio, and public sharing stays off until you explicitly enable it.

security.ownerNote: Only the signed-in owner can manage these records. A temporary account may also receive a secure, browser-bound recovery capability; it is never displayed or included in the record URL.

create.title: Create a private call record
create.detail: This record starts private. You decide whether and when to publish it.
create.privacyNote: Do not enter account emails, credentials, or private session data. Call audio is never stored in a record.
create.capabilityNote: If this temporary session is eligible, management recovery is stored in a secure HttpOnly browser cookie—not in the page or public link.

placeholders.title: Project check-in
placeholders.participants: Names are not added unless you confirm consent below.

consent.create: I have appropriate consent to include these display names if I later publish this record. Without consent, names are not stored.
consent.publicWarning: Publishing makes this record and its participant information available at its public URL. Confirm participant consent before saving.
consent.privateNote: This record remains private until you explicitly publish it.

empty.title: No call records
empty.detail: Create a private summary; you decide if and when to publish it.

notices.created: Private record created. Publishing is an explicit action.
notices.createdWithRecovery: Private record created. A separate recovery credential is saved in this browser so you can still manage it if your temporary session expires.

errors.invalidMetadata: Custom metadata must be valid JSON.
errors.copyFailed: Could not copy the public link

confirm.publish: Publish this record? Its contents and participant information will be available at the public URL only after you confirm.
